import asyncio
from tools.imp03_shared.relay import TCPToTCPRelay, RelayLimits
async def run():
    relay = TCPToTCPRelay(30443, "172.29.44.12", 30443,
                          limits=RelayLimits(max_connections=64))
    await relay.start()
    try:
        await asyncio.Event().wait()
    finally:
        await relay.close()
asyncio.run(run())
